limitations: Native Windows tests use dummy files and actual UAC linked-token AccessCheck; no real broker/provider calls or live training.
Original startup traceback was not saved, so exact historical frame cannot be recovered; original failure and current ACL evidence retained separately from native reproduction.
An already-running process retains earlier token protection code; durable prevention needs manual reload. Installed files and current ACL access do not establish affected runtime recovery.
runtime_implications: Install reviewed source with private recipe and authenticated cache preserved. Migrate only existing credential ACL/owner under its native lock without content changes. Human manual restart required to load durable protection; no trader controls changed.
summary: Scout preserves private Windows token-cache access across normal/elevated launches and records bounded startup exception causes.
